reason: The three candidate-seat interventions from one common deal share the same underlying deal and are statistically dependent. Treating all seat-level deltas as independent would understate uncertainty.
primary_observation: mean of the three candidate-seat reward deltas for each deal

screen.rule: if deal-clustered ci95_high < 0, stop for clear local regression; otherwise continue

local_confirmation.rule: if deal-clustered ci95_high < 0, reject for local regression; otherwise deployment-valid external evaluation remains mandatory

timing_assertion: This amendment was created before inspecting the SCREEN result or any partial reward-delta values. Only checkpoint deal counts/elapsed time had been inspected.
